basic_details.job_title: CSKHPKV Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Chaudhary Sarwan Kumar Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV), Palampur, has invited applications for the post of Project Assistant under Advt No. QSD/VM/6-2/CSKHPKV/26/672-732. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Bank draft drawn in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Sc. (Medical/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology). Knowledge of computer is desirable.
qualification.details: Qualification: B.Sc. (Medical/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology). Knowledge of computer is desirable. | Other conditions: | Knowledge of computer is desirable. | Desirable: | Knowledge of computer

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the University website www.hillagric.ac.in.
Attach the application processing fee as a bank draft in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur.
Send the complete application to the Head, Department of Veterinary Microbiology, DGCN COVAS, CSKHPKV, Palampur - 176062.
Application must reach by 04.12.2026 up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Fee details and other terms and conditions are as per University Notification No. QSD.6-54/CSKHPKV/Rectt/2015/-4750-4849 dated 30.01.2016 (for ICAR-funded projects)
